packageRules.description: Cargo treats a 0.x minor bump as breaking, so it must not ride along in the grouped non-major PR.
The egui crates only compile against their own generation, and they are absent from Renovate's monorepo list.
A toolchain bump can break the build on newly-added lints alone, so it must land on its own rather than take a batch of crate updates down with it.
wasm-bindgen-futures depends on an exact wasm-bindgen version, which Renovate's one-crate-at-a-time `cargo update --precise` can never satisfy; lockFileMaintenance moves the family as a unit instead.
